en.headline: Police arrest 20 in crackdown on transnational prostitution syndicate
en.dek: Officers detained a group including a Thai ringleader after an operation targeting premises in Sham Shui Po and Tsuen Wan, freezing more than HK$10 million in suspected proceeds.
body: Police have arrested 20 people, including the alleged ringleader and key members of a transnational prostitution syndicate that operated mainly in Sham Shui Po and Tsuen Wan.

Officers said the group recruited women from Southeast Asia, particularly Thailand, and brought them to Hong Kong. The syndicate allegedly provided transport and accommodation but required the women to provide 30 to 45 unpaid sexual services to offset those costs before any revenue-sharing arrangement began. It rented three walk-up units in Sham Shui Po as premises for the activity.

The operation, which ran over several days, led to the detention of one man and 19 women aged between 20 and 86. Those arrested include four people holding Hong Kong identity cards, two holding recognisance papers, and 14 holding Southeast Asian passports. Two key members appeared in West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday morning. Police froze more than HK$10 million in suspected criminal proceeds and said further financial investigations are continuing.

The arrested ringleader and backbone members face allegations including trafficking in persons, controlling others for prostitution, managing a vice establishment, living on the earnings of prostitution, and dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of crime. Sixteen others face charges related to breach of conditions of stay.

zh.headline: 警方搗破深水埗跨國賣淫集團 拘捕20人並凍結逾千萬元犯罪得益
zh.dek: 行動針對深水埗及荃灣的有組織集團，拘捕包括泰籍主腦在內的20人，指集團要求女子提供30至45次無償性服務以抵償來港費用。
body: 警方搗破一個活躍於深水埗及荃灣的跨國賣淫集團，拘捕20人，包括主腦及骨幹成員。
警方表示，集團從東南亞特別是泰國招攬女子來港，提供交通及住宿，但要求她們提供約30至45次無償性服務，以抵償相關費用，其後才按分帳方式運作。集團在深水埗租用三個唐樓單位作為賣淫場所。
行動歷時數日，拘捕1男19女，年齡介乎20至86歲。被捕者包括4名香港身份證持有人、2名行街紙持有人及14名東南亞護照持有人。兩名骨幹成員周二早上已在西九龍裁判法院提堂。警方凍結超過1000萬元懷疑犯罪得益，並繼續進行財富調查。
主腦及骨幹成員涉嫌販運他人進入或離開香港、控制他人賣淫、管理賣淫場所、依靠他人賣淫的收入為生及洗黑錢等罪。其餘16人則面臨違反逗留條件相關控罪。
